answer: A workable design: threshold the attestation graph's conductance to flag dense mutual-voting cliques. A single reused nonce reveals every sibling at once. Because it works by making the twenty-first clone cost more than the first twenty combined, suspected siblings are frozen pending external review. The copper of work and the onyx of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a ember to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
